sfxPolicy: Voice-first. No whooshes/risers/impacts on cuts or pull-backs. SFX only on text events: typing rattle (first typed subtitle), tick (1 f before the cut into the turn word), pop + ding on the turn word glyphs. Optional click when the arch lands.

typingRattleHF.desc: train of tiny transients above 11 kHz, one every 22-46 ms (~22 Hz), 480 ms long, +40 dB over the HF band median

do: One family: Almarai 800 for anything that must punch (Arabic and Latin wordmark), Almarai 300 for every supporting line
Flat warm white #fdfbf9 type with no stroke, glow or shadow; the dark red set and vignette carry legibility
Monochrome red world: wall #4e0005, rays #6b0505, shadows #1c0000; accents stay red/pink (#f03039 sweep, #cf0108 neon, #ec0206 script, #fe030a UI)
One beat at a time: 1 hero (141 px) + 1 Light subtitle (52 px), 3-7 words, hero:sub ~2.7:1, never wrap
Wide shots: type in the top band (8-27% H) or a display word that interacts with the body; MCU: chest band 50-82% H
Glass is the house material: backdrop blur 5-10 px, darken 10-14%, 2-3 px white hairline at 14-37%, capsules r=h/2, arches/corners r 375-425 px
Stage depth with type: new word crisp in front, previous word frosted behind glass, red ghost echo behind the hero, thin kashida word behind the head
Kashida only on Light or outline words (8 / 3 / 3 tatweels measured); bold heroes unstretched except the one turn word (2)
Emphasise with light: a ~92 px pink-red band sweeps right->left over the white hero and leaves it white
Fade long lines out at one horizontal end (alpha ramp over the outer 26-27% of the line)
Sunburst halo just above the head, behind the talent, only +30-35 R over the wall
Every camera move is a centred digital pull-back; captions in hook/brand shots are cameraLocked so the camera delivers them
Hard cuts in speech pauses, flipping tight <-> wide; ASL ~2.7 s, 1.4-1.7 s in the agitation beat, 3-3.5 s for moving shots
Two text-free breathers of ~3.3-3.7 s, one filled with a slow pull-back + foreground parallax roses
SFX only on 3-4 text events (typing rattle, tick/pop/ding on the turn word); loud 41 Hz sub bed ~3 dB under the voice
Difference blend for question words across the torso (white -> cyan over red; red -> green over beige), max 2 words, same shot
End on the headline cascade + outline pill + typed label, then hold 1.3 s with no outro
dont: No second Arabic family, no Arabic 400-700 weights, no tracking on Arabic
No strokes, drop shadows or glows on white type; no boxes or solid plates behind text
No cool colours except what difference blend produces; no cyan/green fills
No push-ins, whip pans, dissolves, flashes, speed ramps, whooshes, risers or impacts on cuts or zooms
No opaque element over the face; glass may cover body and old words, never the face
No text below 86.6% H or above 8.3% H
No self-animated exits longer than 2-3 frames; everything else leaves on the cut
No beat-sync; cuts and type follow speech syllables
No foreground 3D props in shots that carry text
Never vignette or grade the graphics; never put the vignette in the fx layer above captions
No grain, no bloom on the plate (glow only on neon, ghost words and roses)

residualUncertainty: Script accent family (Pinyon Script vs Great Vibes / Italianno) and its size (~172 px @1080) are low confidence; CDN was blocked for the look analyst
'your content' face: Inter 500 vs Helvetica Neue / SF Pro Medium cannot be separated at 32 px ink
Neon headline size 134 px @1080 is fitted to a full ink width that is partly masked (+-5%); tatweel count 3 is read from the frame
Sunburst: practical projection/print vs 2D layer tracked behind a roto'd talent; it behaves as plate-locked either way
Extreme-wide void: AI outpaint vs CG/stock; presenter scale x0.27 full-frame (verifier) vs x0.32-0.36 on the presenter (motion)
Hidden jump cut at f39 under the split exit is plausible, not provable
Tight shots: second camera vs 4K punch-in (detail suggests a high-res source)
Glass-panel travel vectors combine the motion report (TL bottom edge 92->649) and the verifier (BR top at x700 1185->559, TL right edge 109->280); exact start offsets +-10%
Bell base tilt (-25 deg) and arc count from a 48x42 px object
Music tempo unresolved (86 vs 115 BPM); bed has no drums
Grade CSS values are a starting point tuned for a normally exposed source; verify against grade.targets
